entropy_block_source: synthetic_enwik8_like_64kib (deterministic Zipf-skewed English/Wiki markup token stream, seed = 0xE1C0_5EBE_4C00_2021)

host_metadata.runner_command: RUSTFLAGS="-C target-cpu=haswell -C target-feature=+bmi2,+avx2,+popcnt -C codegen-units=1 -C llvm-args=-align-loops=32" cargo bench --locked --bench competitor_bench && python3 scripts/bench_compare.py --suite competitor_bench --confirm-retries 5

aho-corasick.notes: BurntSushi Aho-Corasick automaton with SIMD prefilter

bitm.notes: 3-level interleaved rank index (3.125% rank overhead + CombinedSampling select)

bitpacking.notes: Quickwit/Tantivy SIMD bit-packing (128-int blocks, SSE3 4-lane BitPacker4x with SIMD delta integration)

cdivsufsort.notes: C FFI binding to Yuta Mori's libdivsufsort reference implementation

constriction.notes: 64-bit state / 32-bit word rANS coder with 12-bit (4096-entry) O(1) lookup decoder table

divsufsort.notes: Pure-Rust port of Yuta Mori's libdivsufsort induced-sorting suffix array construction

fst.notes: Finite-state transducer minimal acyclic deterministic automaton over sorted keys

hashbrown+ahash.notes: Google SwissTable (AVX2 16-way control byte group probing) with ahash v0.8.12

huffman-compress.notes: Static Order-0 Huffman codebook (BTreeMap<u8, BitVec>) + arena binary tree decoder over bit-vec v0.8.0

libsais.notes: C FFI binding to Ilya Grebnov's libsais induced-sorting suffix array construction (single-threaded)

memchr.notes: BurntSushi AVX2/SSE2 vectorized byte and substring search

mimalloc.notes: Microsoft mimalloc thread-local free-list allocator invoked directly via GlobalAlloc

qp-trie.notes: Quad-bit popcount patricia trie borrowing key slices (&[u8]); bytes/key includes node heap + key backing bytes

radix_trie.notes: 16-way nibble-compressed radix tree with boxed child pointers and Nibblet vectors; bytes/key includes node heap + key backing bytes

rdst.notes: Single-threaded adaptive LSB/Ska radix sort with RadixKey for u32, u64, and (u64, u64) pairs

std::alloc::System.notes: OS system allocator (glibc ptmalloc2 with per-thread tcache)

std::collections::HashMap.notes: Standard library SwissTable (hashbrown backend) with default SipHash-1-3 RandomState

stream-vbyte.notes: stream-vbyte v0.4.1 Scalar backend + delta pass (baseline reference; see stream-vbyte-simd for SSSE3/SSE4.1)

stream-vbyte-simd.notes: stream-vbyte v0.4.1 Encoder/Decoder trait implementation using stable-Rust SSE4.1/SSSE3 intrinsics matching upstream x86::Sse41 / x86::Ssse3

sucds.notes: Broadword bit operations accelerated via hardware intrinsics feature

suffix.notes: BurntSushi pure-Rust SA-IS suffix array construction and binary search

tikv-jemallocator.notes: jemalloc thread-cached arena allocator invoked directly via GlobalAlloc

voracious_radix_sort.notes: Single-threaded hybrid MSD/Ska/LSD radix sort over u32, u64, and Radixable<u64> (u64, u64) pairs

zstd.notes: Whole-block LZ77 + FSE + 4-stream Huffman compressor at levels 1 and 3 with reused ZSTD_CCtx / ZSTD_DCtx (not an order-0 coder; raw huff0/FSE stages are benchmarked separately under zstd_huf0 and zstd_fse)

zstd_fse.api_used: HIST_count_wksp + FSE_normalizeCount + FSE_writeNCount + FSE_buildCTable_wksp + FSE_compress_usingCTable & FSE_decompress_wksp_bmi2
zstd_fse.notes: Raw libzstd FSE (Finite State Entropy / tANS) Order-0 entropy stage (table build + header + stream encode/decode, no LZ77)

zstd_huf0.notes: Raw libzstd huff0 4-stream Order-0 Huffman entropy stage (table build + header + 4X stream encode/decode, no LZ77)
